title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 53
description: Ten questions on Psalms 53: the fool who says there is no God, God looking down from heaven, and the hope that salvation comes out of Zion.

questions.text: Who says in his heart, "There is no God"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:1 says, "The fool has said in his heart, 'There is no God.'"

questions.text: According to verse 3, who does good?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:3 says, "There is no one who does good, no, not one."

questions.text: From where does God look down on the children of men?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:2 says, "God looks down from heaven on the children of men."

questions.text: What is God looking for when he looks down on the children of men?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:2 says he looks to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

answers.text: Any who are rich and strong
Any who build him a house
Any who understood and seek after God

questions.text: According to verse 3, what have they become together?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:3 says, "Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together."

questions.text: The workers of iniquity eat up God's people as they eat what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:4 says they "eat up my people as they eat bread."

questions.text: Where were they in great fear, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:5 says, "There they were in great fear, where no fear was."

answers.text: In the valley of the shadow
At the gates of the city

questions.text: Whose bones has God scattered, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:5 says, "God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you."

questions.text: Out of where does the psalmist wish the salvation of Israel would come?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:6 says, "Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion!"

questions.text: Who shall rejoice when God brings back his people from captivity?
questions.explanation: Psalms 53:6 says, "When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad."
